notes.title: Big update with optimizations
notes.notes:
General Fixes
-Massive optimizations throughout all maps
-level design fixes, (holes duplicated meshes ..etc.)
-All big trees are now climbable throughout the summer level map

-fixed issue with spawned giraffes in night level won't walk around.

-general fixes and enhancement for snow Level

-fixed most of the clipping that would let the player see behind the rocks that are placed as boundaries around the map(summer level )
-added a death trigger to restart level incase player fell below the map.

-Fixed the hitches while loading the first cinematics(when u start the game)
-Fixed crash when the game is set to full screen in game settings. 
-Fixed the issue where save slots prevent the ability to start a new level 
-Fixed the issue where loading a save game prevents the player from spawning giraffes 
-Fixed the issue where entering ocean level or winter level while riding the whale will make the game stuck in loading.
-Reduced the flickering while the player is riding the whale in the winter level.


Enhancements 
-Reduce Default mouse sensitivity to reduce the motion sickness caused by it. ( it still can be edited from settings)
-changed crosshair.
-added cloud shadows for summer level.
-Enhanced summer level water splash particles. (more optimized with higher density)
-Added two way portal to connect the area around the winter entrance to the area around the lake.
-subtitles for intro video
-jump pads ( green mushrooms) in summer level
